items.html: And this is the secret of what our sages, may their memory be blessed, said on 'I shall fill the desolated': Tyre was not filled except from the ruin of Jerusalem. For Jerusalem, which is the Nukva of ZA of holiness, was destroyed and remained in the secret of a single point alone. And Tyre, which is Lilith the wicked, her rival — 'a handmaid that dispossesses her mistress' — was filled and became a complete Partzuf of ten Sefirot, from what was destroyed of Jerusalem, which are the nine first Sefirot.
